components.role: Unchanged official Takara Tomy 2008 sixth-edition product page; identifies Junior and Millionaire stages, combined play and August 2008 release. Edition provenance, not an additional manual.

jinsei-game.evidence: Complete unchanged eight-page original Japanese Takara Tomy Jinsei Game manual, copyright 1968/2008, product JAN 4904810301912, downloaded directly from the publisher support archive. The publisher product page independently identifies this as the sixth edition, released August 2008, with Junior and Millionaire stages and combined play. This is the named Japanese Jinsei Game family, BGG 145428, and its Junior childhood/school-to-career stage matches the local description; no Western LIFE manual or themed Adventure/MOVE/Jumbo Dream substitute is used. Accepted scope is explicitly the 2008 sixth edition, not a facsimile or certification of every edition since 1968. All eight original page images were visually inspected. The manual contains components, physical setup, banker/turn order/initial money, Junior movement and allowance spaces, mandatory STOPs and school-trip branches, borrowing and careers, Junior finish/scoring, Millionaire setup/movement/paydays, marriage/branch/settlement STOPs, debt and repayment, career changes/rank-ups, insurance, stocks, treasure cards, marriage/children, house purchase/exchange, gambling/revenge, settlement, finish/final asset valuation and combined-stage carryover. Native PDF text is severely corrupted and was not used. Fresh forced Japanese OCR was run separately over all eight pages using locally downloaded Japanese language data. The Japanese-only OCR remains imperfect, including numbers, furigana, columns, card names and diagram labels. Clearly labelled short visually checked Japanese readings accompany the raw OCR; the unchanged original PDF governs every numerical value and diagram. This is an original Japanese source, not an official or machine-generated English translation. The printed board, cards, spinner and physical components remain necessary; their full faces are not recreated by the manual. One specific MAJOR finding is recorded for the covered 2008 scoring/component scope: the summary substitutes hidden-value LIFE tiles for the original treasure-card and final-asset system. No full summary audit, PASS or body repair.
